clauses.clause: Driving control ≤ 0.5 s after load; roster + durability carried; corgi never inside the hull; rider's legs inside the cab.
clauses.note: Correct production transport saves preserve APC IDs721low/466high, durability990/1000 and every24/25non-driver occupant ID. Actual physicalW acceptedtick0; meaningful traction>0.5m/s bytick4/0.0667s, below0.5s. Across181snapshots per tier corgi is deliberately hidden and absent from drawn vehicle meshes; eight reviewed arrival/steering panels show seated courier legs within the open cab. Earlier omitted-transport/default runs are excluded explicitly. Shared load clocks9.174s/5.171s are not used as quiet L8-10 timing qualification.
